missions.name: Refill your water
missions.cue: Walk to the tap, fill your bottle, drink a glass there.

missions.name: Climb the stairs
missions.cue: Two floors up and back down. No stairs nearby? Walk at a brisk pace instead.

missions.name: Go for a walk
missions.cue: A lap of the floor, the building or the block, at your usual pace. No phone.

missions.name: Daylight walk
missions.cue: A slow walk outside, or to an open window. Take in the natural light and some fresh air.

missions.name: Tidy run
missions.cue: Take your cup to the kitchen, bin something, come back.
